steps.text: The connection between us will transcend even time and space. I am sure of it.

Even if the ocean completely boils away and the atmosphere vanishes, even if all the moons in the sky are pulled into the vortex of our planet's gravity, and even if the sun continues to mercilessly expand, eventually swallowing up all its children until none can be heard...
I am sure we will meet again. At the far end of our civilization, once adorned by darkness and the brilliance of the stars up above, we will meet once again.
I will wait until that day comes. I promise you I will. Wait for me. You must wait for me too.
...Don't ever forget about me.
Is it time...?
I should still be alive. This can't be an illusion.
This is the Rhodes Island I'm familiar with, and it seems to be operating as usual. Therefore, It is definitely not here yet.

spans.text: This is the Rhodes Island I'm familiar with, and it seems to be operating as usual. Therefore,

steps.text: Is she still asleep? What of Originium's current state...?
And as for the changes happening to this planet...
You're still here, AMa-10.
Perfect... Let's go for a walk outside.
From a distance away, a black-haired woman dressed in a white coat stands on the deck, concentrating her gaze at the sky.
Until she notices the two of you and turns around, a bright smile on her face.
You are absolutely certain you have seen this face before.
Perhaps in a dream within dreams, or in the depths of your dormant memories.
But this moment is no dream.
You can clearly perceive her presence and existence right before you with each of your senses.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, this woman... is the Priestess you talked about?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The enemy Dr. Kal'tsit has been guarding against...?
Amiya does not understand the danger she faces, but still she stands in front of you instinctively, ready to engage in combat.
You are unable to determine how exactly the current situation will unfold, but know very well this is not at all like any powerful foe or crisis you have faced before.
The woman seems to show no hostility, but still your instinct tells you—unfathomable danger lies right before your eyes.
Gently, she begins to speak.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You're a step ahead of me, {@nickname}.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You didn't wait for me in the awakening room, to share a mutual joy in seeing this new world for the first time.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: But how could I possibly blame you for a little impatience?
You also feel her pure, sincere gaze.
From the distance wind blows and thunder rolls, along with the faint rustling of Originium spreading.
Within the clamor and chaos of this space, she fixes her eyes on you as if nothing else exists.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: This reunion is not what I expected, but I'm willing to accept an unorthodox experience.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: We've dreamed together too many times to count, how we would meet again when we awoke from our deep sleep.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: We could wander freely on this planet completely covered by Originium, in a world that belonged only to us.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: A world only one step away from our shared, ultimate vision, and we'd walk towards our new hope...

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: It ought to be a bright, sunny day too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, look! The clouds in the sky—
Amiya hurriedly shouts a warning at you when she notices the sky's unnatural appearance.
But you fail to comprehend just what your eyes are currently seeing.
As soon as Priestess finishes speaking, thick Catastrophe clouds begin to contract and fold in a neat yet strange manner until they vanish completely, leaving a canvas-like sky.
Catastrophes, the most horrific disasters to happen to this land—gone, just like that.
You realize a terrible truth.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: {@nickname}, your question sounds like you're asking a stranger.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: We created it together. A crystallization that belongs to only the two of us, a seed of hope.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: But tragically... you don't remember anymore, do you?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I know you lost part of your memories in a series of unfortunate accidents.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: It's a pity, but I believe your partial memory loss will not change your nature, and the connection between us remains unshakable.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I've no wish to be harsh on you, but I hope you can understand—time is short, and we have much to do.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Though, we can still enjoy our time working together, yes?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Return to my side, Dr. {@nickname}...

a.text: Create a bridge to the future.

spans.text: Create a bridge to the future.

steps.text: The gentle call seems to ring suddenly in your ears, and you feel incomparably close to the voice.
You are certain you cannot recall a single shred of her in your mind, yet your connection goes beyond memories, or perhaps information contained in language.
An almost instinctive reaction.
You cannot help but take a step forward.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}!
Kal'tsit is behind you, gripping your arm. You feel feeble tremors through her palm.
You realize now she has been silent the whole time. Since leaving the sarcophagus, she has been so weak, at this point, she even seems to be struggling to stand.
You are baffled.
You expected Kal'tsit to give you some sage advice, like usual, or perhaps a simple and clear solution.
But now she seems to be suffering from terrible torment, her face bearing struggle and pain.
After an endless instant, she loosens her grip.
She leaves the choice for you to make.

options: I won't let Originium destroy Terra.

steps.text: You see her eyes darken. A clear sign of disappointment. You don't know why, but your heart suddenly tightens.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: So it's you... AMa-10. It's been a long time for us too.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Your current appearance is vastly different from the look you were born with, but I certainly recognize my very own creation that I poured my heart into.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: In the past four million plus natural day cycles, you seem to have exerted a lot of effort, but your behavioral standards appear to clash with the preset goal encoded at your birth.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I'd like to know just what changed your mind.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Unlike your despicable fraud...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...My end goal has never changed.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Indeed... you regarded that one's order as an inviolable mandate.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: So you hindered the Originium plan, and wasted our already limited time.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: So, {@nickname}, how should I make you understand—

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Just how disappointed I am?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: And how should I forgive your betrayal?

options: Kal'tsit, what is the meaning of this?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I've noticed, AMa-10.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You've already broken the language ban I put in place, correct?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Such a precaution was not enough to restrict your actions, for you always find a way...

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: But if that's the case, why not just say it?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Everything you've wanted to say to {@nickname} this whole time, but couldn't?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Priestess...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: *Expletive from an unknown language*.
Ascalon and the Elite Operators are momentarily stunned after entering the rift.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: This is the Abyss?!

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Raidian, can you confirm if we're still inside the Rhodes Island landship?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Unable to detect any electromagnetic signals outside this space. Hm... no way to tell.
Everyone falls into brief silence, waiting for a commander's directive as usual.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Where's the Doctor?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: And where are Dr. Kal'tsit and Amiya?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Once we entered the rift, I lost track of their positions.
Constant white noise fills the vast white space, the sound of operating machinery emanating from the center.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: If this place is indeed the Abyss, then clearly it's distorting our perception of physical space.
Mantra's voice comes to everyone's minds as they learn this at the same time.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: There's no way to identify the material the walls are made of.
He looks back in the rift's direction, but it is no longer there.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Currently there's no way to cut open these strange walls, so there's no way to confirm their whereabouts.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: I trust Amiya and Dr. Kal'tsit will manage to keep the Doctor safe.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: We can only wait and adapt accordingly.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: We haven't received any new commands, so we should continue executing our original task.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: Then let's not delay any longer.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: Mechanist, Sharp and I will cover you while you close in on that unknown machine. Verify if its related to PRTS.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: We can back you up anytime—

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Something's off. There are no high-threat targets here.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That's unusual.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: According to Dr. Kal'tsit and the Doctor's speculations, the Originium entities we've run into all come from the Abyss...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But there's like no defenses installed here at all—

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I hear... pain.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What's wrong, kitten?

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Rosmontis, do you feel any other abnormalities within your body?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No, it's not my own...
A huge black vortex spins slowly under the transparent floor. It starts to speed up.
The unidentifiable instrument right above it begins to flash red.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Detecting a large amount of interference signals.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: That instrument is currently transmitting a huge volume of data—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Could the black vortex underneath... be a visualization of all that information?

a.text: Loading threat targets data files, generating targeted countermeasure strategies...
This is a final warning from PRTS.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Gah, so we're intruders now?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Doesn't look like you're giving us any option to leave though.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: So, Ascalon?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Sweep up Rhodes Island's trash.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Nice, I like that.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Don't care where all this stuff came from, but we'll let them know just to whom Rhodes Island belongs.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, ever since you woke up in Chernobog, I have refrained from confessing the whole truth about your past.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The ban placed on me is only part of the cause.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As for the other reasons... I have said before no one else should tell you about your past.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Language has no way of reconstructing objective facts, while emotions will distort its delivery.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So I needed you to see and judge for yourself, to re-evaluate this land on your own.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only then could you formulate your own answers about how you regard this land, and about yourself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I still believe it's important to do it this way.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The same way someone once treated me.

options: I am the Doctor of Rhodes Island.
I am a soul walking this vast land.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This may be the last chance I have to share that information, however.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Perhaps only now do I, too, have the confidence to share it after all that you and Rhodes Island have been through together.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Please trust that I talk only of your past, and it has nothing to do with your future.
Kal'tsit walks up by your side, facing you and Amiya.
She slowly begins to speak.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, you ought to already know that Originium, a bearer of both life and danger to Terra, is the legacy of a previous age.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It was one of countless methods used by the previous civilization against an ultimate threat.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: After countless efforts and sacrifices, Originium was finally completed by Oracle and Priestess.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'Oracle' was your previous code name.

options: ...I was the one who brought suffering upon this land?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Please know that was not your intention.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Originium points to two futures for this land... Oracle hoped to leave Originium as a gift for future civilizations, to guide them forward...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: To help them enter the next stage of civilization.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Over the past ten thousand years, Originium has helped civilization on Terra to develop, but also unexpectedly brought suffering to the land via Oripathy.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You were indeed tormented by this before.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I still remember... when the Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Doctor has never given up the possibility of curing Oripathy.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: However, someone forced a different future upon you. And for this... you made a choice that went against your original intentions.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Someone once told me to trust in your character, to look for your true self, beyond what memory shapes you. It was an incomparably difficult path for me to walk.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But I'm glad... it was the correct choice to make.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, that's all I wanted to tell you. They are only your past, and you will always be able to decide your own future.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Then I too... will fulfill my oath.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I will protect you and Amiya until the end.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is not the best opportunity to do so, but it is my final one.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm sorry, to entrust such a risk to you and Amiya... but this is a choice I must make.
You see Kal'tsit's mouth move, her final words.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Are you done? You've said what you wanted to say?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I'm astonished by how much you know about the past, and I don't completely agree with how you've described it... but that's no longer important.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: AMa-10, what can you even achieve as you are now?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Mon3tr!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Excited whinny)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Destroy her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She is the Priestess of a previous civilization. Creator of Originium, and attempting to assimilate everything within it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And therefore, the enemy of all life on Terra.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: So this is your choice...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm Kal'tsit, a doctor of Rhodes Island, and also the companion of Amiya and the Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You have long been worthless to me.
